payload.text: `intent claude start <node>` hands the launched session the same brief and takes its launch steps from the profile, so that on a board with a mediator a seat other than the mediator is told to send its plan to the mediator and take its go from it, and the mediator is told to show its plan to hv; on a board that declares no profile the launch reads as it did before this thread; and its refusal of an unregistered moniker names `intent wb init`.
